test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Given below are six sentences taken from a paragraph. The first and the last sentences are numbered S1 and S2 and are placed in the first and last positions respectively. The other four sentences between the first and last sentences are jumbled up and are numbered A, B, C, and D. Rearrange the jumbled sentences in a logical sequence keeping the unity and coherence of the paragraph intact. Choose the correct alternative that best describes the sequence
solution: The correct answer is: (3) CDAB. S1 details falling ill; C specifies the location and summoning help; D describes the doctor arriving; A covers the treatment and initiation of talk; B explains the narrator's exhaustion and willingness to chat. This sequence logically links the start of an illness to the social interaction before tea is served.
